mentions.name: EntryCast
mentions.description: A recently built product sold at entrycast.com, created to serve the author's specific personal use cases and offered for purchase to others, though similar products already exist on the market. The comment does not describe what the product does.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently built https://entrycast.com/ - there are other products kind of like it on the market already but I had some specific use cases I wanted personally, and decided rather than making it just for me, I'd for the first time in my life make it something others could buy too.
